descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you curious about how energy transition, regulation, technology and capital markets intersect? Do you enjoy connecting dots across sectors, analyzing data, and turning complex topics into clear insights? We are looking for an intern to:
• assist in the preparation of thematic and cross-sector research reports (e.g. energy transition, ESG, regulation-driven themes)
• analyze proprietary and public datasets, extracting insights and narratives rather than building financial models
• contribute to research pieces that are externally published
• participate in calls and meetings with companies, policymakers and industry experts
• support analysts in daily research activities, including trend monitoring and content organization
• monitor global and local market trends
• track economic and regulatory developments relevant to energy transition and sustainability
• support networking initiatives through ARC (Analytical Research Community)
